AboutPage.title: About us
AboutPage.subtitle: We protect your rights
AboutPage.description1: Sher Legal Law Firm was founded in 2022 by a talented and ambitious lawyer and blogger, Sherzod Egamberdiev.
AboutPage.description2: The idea to create a unique brand that combines a legal consulting firm and legal services emerged during his university years.
AboutPage.description3: Even as a student, Sherzod dreamed of creating a company that would provide comprehensive legal support and high-quality legal representation. He saw the need to integrate the best practices of consulting and law to solve the most complex legal issues.
